proof.text: For ProjectionTensorCoefficient.good, apply flat_iff and kflat_iff of ringIso_tensor_transport to the quotient-normalized coefficient isomorphism, translating the independent-coefficient K-flat predicate to the existing pro-etale predicate. This previously proved theorem is preserved. The unchanged proof is now checked as a private helper in ProjectionTensorNormalization and the original theorem delegates to it.

For completion_isIso, obtain the tensor presentation T and derived completeness of T(M,N) from constructibleTensorCompletion. Fully faithful precomposition with the product good-complex localization lifts the ratio of its representative comparison and t.ordinary.representative to an isomorphism T ≅ t.ordinary.tensor. The canonicalCompletionUnitCriterion and naturality of the completion unit transfer invertibility from T(M,N) to t.ordinary.tensor(M,N). Tensor.chi is that unit followed by t.comparison, an isomorphism, so is invertible. No uniqueness of arbitrary Roos triangle lifts is used. The unchanged proof is checked as a private helper in ProjectionTensorModelComparison; the original theorem retains its signature and delegates to it.

For ordinary_existsUnique, restrict DerivedCategory.Q to the flat-term K-flat full subcategory. The existing goodComplexes_isLocalization theorem identifies this restriction as a localization, so product precomposition is fully faithful. The signed-total inverse maps form a natural isomorphism by tensorPullbackTotal_naturality; their inverses are the specified totalIso. Apply normalizedTensorDescent from ProjectionTensorNormalization, which wraps tensorComparisonDescent with the two representative comparisons, the exact coefficient factor isomorphism, and good. Postcompose its normalization square by the target representative inverse to obtain the requested square. Conversely cancel that inverse to recover the descent square. Thus the existence and uniqueness clauses transfer without changing any resolving certificate or comparison map.

Apply models_comparison from ProjectionTensorModelComparison. It constructs the representative-normalized ratio by product localization and proves compatibility with chi using equality of the two-coordinate augmentation chains.

Whisker this model comparison by coefficient transport. The normalization square for ordinaryComparison_s becomes the square for ordinaryComparison_t after the representative equation, so ordinary_existsUnique identifies these ordinary comparisons. Inverting the two constructible chi maps and cancelling the model comparison proves integralArrow is independent of the model.

Choose a normalized tensor model using lem-sf-tensor-completion-model-existence. Map the inverse of its chi by exact coefficient transport and compose with ordinaryComparison. The integral_identity functor equality supplies the literal underlying endpoint equalities. Transport along them and use the full-subcategory iso constructor. The model-independence equation verifies the required HEq for every model. Two normalized lifts have equal underlying homs by evaluation at the chosen model; full-subcategory and iso extensionality give uniqueness.

Fix one normalized tensor-completion model t, whose existence is already proved. Restrict t.chi to constructible input pairs; all its components are isomorphisms by completion_isIso. Invert this natural isomorphism, whisker by exact coefficient transport, and compose with ordinaryComparison. The integral_identity equality identifies its source and target functors with the full inclusions of integralTensor followed by the recorded integral coefficient equivalence and the target ordinary tensor. The normalization of integralComparison says its underlying component homs are the same maps. Transport naturality across these functor equalities and use faithfulness of the full inclusion to prove integralComparison naturality.

Assemble integralComparison into an integral natural isomorphism using its proved naturality. Apply rationalTensorDescent to that natural isomorphism and R.Normalized. This proved helper verifies the source and target coefficient-1 restriction equalities, applies fully faithful precomposition with the product raw localization, and proves exactly the required integral-representative HEq normalization and uniqueness. Thus rational_existsUnique and its existing comparison definition have no remaining holes.

title: Canonical coefficient comparison for the constructible tensor
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$, its coefficient datum $c$ with prime $\ell\ne p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $T_0$ with geometric fibre $T$, and a finite coefficient field $E\subset c.\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Let $F$ be the normalized coefficient comparison system [def-fd-coefficient-comparison-datum] [def-fd-pullback-comparison-datum] and $W$ its geometric-Frobenius fixed-pair comparison [def-sf-projection-weil-coefficient-comparison]. The canonical coefficient tensor comparison identifies the coefficient image of the framework rational tensor [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] with the ordinary rational tensor of a normalized comparison $R$ [def-sf-projection-weil-tensor-comparison]. It is defined by the following normalization. The ordinary coefficient tensor and signed-total comparison [def-sf-projection-coefficient-tensor-total] is as follows. Ordinary scalar restriction through the quotient-normalized completed ring isomorphism sends every local pure tensor $x\otimes y$ to that same tensor of the restricted sections. Sum its inverse over all bidegrees with the signed total differential, and descend the resulting comparison on flat-term K-flat representatives through the two tensor representative isomorphisms and the exact coefficient-transport factorization. The integral normalization is required for every normalized tensor-completion presentation [def-sf-tensor-completion-comparison], whose representative square fixes the quotient coordinate and zero shifted coordinate. Such presentations exist by [lem-fix-constructible-tensor-completion], so this normalization is nonvacuous. On integral constructible objects, first apply the inverse of the actual quotient-tower completion unit of [lem-fix-constructible-tensor-completion], then this ordinary derived comparison, and lift through the full integral inclusion. Finally localize this uniquely prescribed integral comparison on every unchanged integral representative, using the object and pure-tensor normalizations of $F$ and $R$. This defines a unique natural isomorphism of the two indicated rational tensor bifunctors; it retains every rational denominator and requires no integral lift of a rational Weil structure.
